verdict.rationale: Consensus documents an AI-powered Library workspace. Users import their own papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF or RIS, then search the collection and "find gaps". The product also generally synthesizes literature with cited insights. However, the evidence for AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's own data is marketing-level and thin. missing for 10: concrete documentation of what insights or suggestions are generated from a user's imported library, details of gap-finding output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.
Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.
